item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I am now the headache.

I've never really been a fan of the Black Queen's articles. They don't appeal to me, for the sole reason that it seems less of a group and more of an esoteric case of DID spliced with multiverse hopping. I'm also not too wild about crossing the streams and meshing -J's with regular articles, because that just opens up a whole new series of questions. Nor do I enjoy having to cock my head at a 45 degree angle in order to read a character's dialogue.

But this is great. It's a fantastic little look into how all the varieties have their own quirks and traits that enable them to contribute to the task at hand, which ultimately requires all of their efforts to solve. So you've got:

-good writing
-appropriate use of the format, and
-technical supremacy

It's good.
